shared_or_similar_visual_information: A shaded region with an adjacent unshaded interior cutout or excluded part. On the left, use the light-blue patch inside the large semicircle and above both smaller arcs. On the right, use the shaded parts inside the circle and outside the central white diamond.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It comprises the large semicircle minus the two unshaded smaller semicircles. Right image: The selected circular part is the disk with the inner square excluded. The additional corner shading is outside the circle.
Rationales: The shade identifies the remainder after leaving designated pieces out of an enclosing geometric area. Those pieces must be removed from the area computation in each panel.
